endpoint_input_audit.boundary: Compared original protocol, recorded before/after manifests and per-process fast identities. Later helper/H1/source/build changes cannot be qualified by these historical hashes; endpoint equality is not continuous monitoring.

limits: One shared-host descriptive batch; no causal attribution, confidence interval or performance-equivalence conclusion.
No displayed-frame deadline, smoothness, audio deadline, physical fidelity, native accessibility, host/device or release acceptance.
No qualification of helper-integrated, H1-integrated, current-gallery or future published combined-source performance.
Only total samples are available; paint and flush/present summaries cannot be independently recomputed.
The batching field is SDL_GetHint, not internal renderer batching readback; software renderer flags do not prove display-vsync behavior.
Original v1 setup and paired-comparator failures and all pins remain retained.

method.threshold: For either median or p95, strictly >2 ms AND strictly >15%, evaluated with exact integer cross multiplication.

preserved_failure.exact_correction: Remove only SDL_RENDER_BATCHING from child environment; native hint remains 1. No changed native binaries, counts, order, CPU or thresholds.
preserved_failure.failure_before_initialization_and_painti: Source setup SDL_SetHint assertion precedes SDL_Init; retained stderr identifies this assertion.

recorded_batch.root_quiet_interval_statement: Root reserves this interval with no controlled builds, tests, captures, or other native workloads. Workers are restricted to source inspection, patch preparation, and documentation. CPU 0 affinity does not reserve the shared host; unrelated external host activity is unknown.

scope: Independent offline audit of retained reports, all eight raw timing stdout/stderr streams, 2400 total samples, both same-scene raw Flat witnesses, source pins and historical endpoint manifests. No current combined-source performance admission.
